sources.supports: OpenAI currently lists GPT-5 Chat cached input at $0.125 per million tokens.

notes: The current OpenAI model page confirms the added cache rate but does not establish when it took effect or what OpenAI charged during the earlier models.dev period. The OpenAI launch announcement extraction was denied (403), and the Internet Archive request returned 429, so the earlier official price cannot be verified from quotable source files.
